headline_marked: Messi nets hat-trick as [[Argentina beats Algeria]] in World Cup opener
headline: Messi nets hat-trick as Argentina beats Algeria in World Cup opener
summary: Lionel Messi equalled Miroslav Klose's all-time World Cup goalscoring record with 16 goals after a stunning performance in Kansas City.
details: Lionel Messi equalled the all-time record for goals at World Cup tournaments, netting his 16th goal as Argentina defeated Algeria in their opening match on Tuesday.
The 38-year-old captain scored a long-range strike in the first half and a close-range finish in the second, completing his hat-trick in the 76th minute.
Messi became the first man to play in six different World Cup tournaments, a record that Cristiano Ronaldo may equal if he plays for Portugal against DR Congo on Wednesday.
The eight-time Ballon d'Or winner, who led Argentina to victory in Qatar 2022, had previously announced that the 2022 edition would be his last, but later changed his mind.
Argentina's all-time top-scorer is now just the third man to reach 200 international caps, joining Cristiano Ronaldo and Kuwait's Bader Al-Mutawa.
Currently playing for Inter Miami in the MLS, Messi has remained in top form, scoring 13 goals in 16 games in 2026.
caption:
16 World Cup goals and a hat-trick! Lionel Messi just equalled the all-time record.

Lionel Messi equalled the all-time record for goals at World Cup tournaments, netting his 16th goal as Argentina defeated Algeria in their opening match on Tuesday.

The 38-year-old captain scored a long-range strike in the first half and a close-range finish in the second, completing his hat-trick in the 76th minute.

Messi became the first man to play in six different World Cup tournaments, a record that Cristiano Ronaldo may equal if he plays for Portugal against DR Congo on Wednesday.

The eight-time Ballon d'Or winner, who led Argentina to victory in Qatar 2022, had previously announced that the 2022 edition would be his last, but later changed his mind.

Argentina's all-time top-scorer is now just the third man to reach 200 international caps, joining Cristiano Ronaldo and Kuwait's Bader Al-Mutawa.

Currently playing for Inter Miami in the MLS, Messi has remained in top form, scoring 13 goals in 16 games in 2026.

headline_marked: Kylian Mbappé [[becomes France's all-time top scorer]]
headline: Kylian Mbappé becomes France's all-time top scorer
summary: The French star surpassed Zinedine Zidane's record in a dominant performance against Senegal.
details: Kylian Mbappé has officially become the highest goalscorer in the history of the France national team. He achieved this historic milestone during a match against Senegal.
The match saw France secure a victory, with Mbappé surpassing the previous record held by legendary midfielder Zinedine Zidane.
In addition to Mbappé's record-breaking feat, teammate Bradley Barcola also contributed to the scoreline, helping France lead 2-0.
Despite a strong start from Senegal in the first half, France eventually took control of the game and secured the win.
caption:
A new era of French football begins. Mbappé has officially surpassed Zidane to become France's all-time top scorer!

Kylian Mbappé has officially become the highest goalscorer in the history of the France national team. He achieved this historic milestone during a match against Senegal.

The match saw France secure a victory, with Mbappé surpassing the previous record held by legendary midfielder Zinedine Zidane.

In addition to Mbappé's record-breaking feat, teammate Bradley Barcola also contributed to the scoreline, helping France lead 2-0.

Despite a strong start from Senegal in the first half, France eventually took control of the game and secured the win.
